title: Trump says government documents will drop the term artificial intelligence
friendlyTitle: Trump says government documents will stop using the words artificial intelligence
summary: The Hill reports that President Trump wrote on Truth Social that the administration will ban the term 'AI/Artificial Intelligence' in 'all relevant documents, and everything else,' and replace it with 'super intelligence,' which he calls more accurate. He signed an executive order in September directing the executive branch to use that term. Earlier this month he announced a Super Intelligence Force, led by Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton, to coordinate federal work with companies and infrastructure providers.

whyItMatters: This is a naming rule for government paper, not a ban on the tools. If you write for a US agency, bid on a contract, or read a federal notice, the label on the page may change while the system does not. The Hill's account is the post and the existing order. It does not describe a statute that stops a company, or a person, from saying AI.
